objective: Build an independently source-pinned persistent full-historical-train factual-weight image and a read-only native semantic query bridge for Yggdrasil, NOT projecting facts into its unrelated 16-slot causal cells. Materialize every TRAIN triple (no reserved valid/test), not a small fixture or sample. Preserve identity, relationship type, exact evidence, source snapshot and cold restoration.

source.source_age: historical snapshot; not verified current facts

representation.index: memory-mapped sorted full numerical triple file; binary search on exact subject/predicate
representation.source_ref: immutable historical train manifest plus packed SHA256
representation.native_model_layer: experimental standalone typed factual store; Yggdrasil 16-slot NKR04 action-consequence memory unchanged
representation.full_train_exposure: all historical TRAIN groups including previously consumed WSP103-held query groups; these are no longer fresh evaluation labels

build.artifact: full historical TRAIN-only source-pinned model image in bounded GitHub Action artifact with declared expiry; not checked into Git source
build.operator: external sort + binary searchable mmap, no stochastic training
build.records_scope: all 21343681 historical TRAIN rows; no masked withheld groups because objective full knowledge

controls.independent_exact_symbolic: same source set for in-fixture parity
controls.frozen_conventional: not a learning superiority experiment; matching inference/compute comparison reserved
controls.semantic_truth: retains source Q/P/Q relations only; no causal interpretation invented
controls.novel_discovery: not asserted; typed path hypotheses labeled as hypotheses

gates.preflight: Ubuntu and Windows focused source-free tests, G29 pin and full root regression on candidate SHA/tree
gates.primary: one source-qualified single-run full TRAIN scan on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu after all preflight pass; archive and train bytes+SHA+predicate count+row count exact, fully populated file and manifest SHA/cold mmap readback, tests with exact source
gates.post: after source test whole root regression on same exact SHA; no source edits after results
gates.science: SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false; original inference and protected source unopened
gates.admission: research image not accepted model, no main or owners mutated

stop_rules: missing source/repository right or mismatched digest
failed code fixture or G29 or root regression any OS
native semantic facts mapped to 16-slot action consequences
source manifest or numerical file hash mismatch
